title: Agent Control Flow Patterns: ReAct vs. Plan-and-Execute in 2026
excerpt: ReAct and plan-and-execute solve the same problem differently: deciding one step at a time versus committing to a plan up front. Here's when each one holds up, and where it breaks in production.
seo_title: Agent Control Flow Patterns: ReAct vs Plan-and-Execute
meta_description: Agent control flow patterns compared: when a ReAct loop beats a fixed plan-and-execute graph, and how to bound either one before it runs away in production.
social_message:
I rebuilt the same agent three times before admitting I'd picked the wrong control flow pattern.

ReAct and plan-and-execute solve the same problem two different ways: decide one step at a time, or commit to the whole plan up front. Here's when each one holds up, the official create_agent middleware for capping a runaway loop, and why create_react_agent is already deprecated.

Read the full guide 👉 https://www.firstevolvenextscale.com/agent-control-flow-patterns/
